unit.why: A short anecdote: the Apter Rebbe shows great honour to the young Ruzhiner, onlookers wonder at it, and he explains himself with a midrash and an oath.

stories.start_quote: הה״ק מאפטא ז"ל עשה כבוד גדול
stories.end_quote: נשבע אני בזקני כי המדרש כוון עליו
stories.summary_en: The Apter Rebbe pays great honour to the young Rebbe of Ruzhin and, when people wonder at it, cites a midrash about those who will sit with the Patriarchs in the future world and swears by his beard that it refers to him.

quotes: עשה כבוד גדול להה״ק מריזין בעודנו צעיר לימים
tags.why: An elder tsaddik honours a younger tsaddik.

quotes: איתא במדרש לעתיד לבא עתידין לחיות תמהין
tags.why: The Apter Rebbe answers with a quoted midrash he applies as a teaching.

quotes: והרי הוא יושב עם האבות ומסיח מהן
tags.why: The midrash concerns the righteous in the world to come.

quotes: נשבע אני בזקני כי המדרש כוון עליו
tags.why: He discerns the young man's exalted soul-level, which others cannot see.
The tale's point is to praise the Ruzhiner's greatness.
Onlookers wonder at the honour shown; this borders on reverence for the tsaddik.

missing_concepts: honour shown by an elder tsaddik to a young one
